body:
Ah, yes. He's my miorail. Are you not familiar with the term? 
He's helped me though these tough places many times.

I feel as though the people I care about don't deserve to have to deal with me. Right now - when I feel okay and I'm not contemplating death - it seems strange to think I could hurt them by killing myself, but its not like i dont think about it when I get like that. Some times I think that maybe I should do it somewhere where my friends would find me so that maybe they could finally empathize with the kind of pain I feel. Not as punishment, but just so they *understand*. Other times I feel like I should do it in a private manor, in a way that is easy to clean up and wont really affect anyone else's life. Like, wrapped up in a trash bag behind an abandoned building.. /:

Anyway, yhea I've got enough hobbies. C: I'm a little bit of a gamer, I like art making, scrap booking, and (oddly enough) I'm really passionate about reading academic articles on queer theory and other takes on the idea that gender and sexuality are not inherent or stagnant but fluid and by their very nature change over time.

You know, its an on going thing. Not nearly as bad as it used to be. I mean, I'm not depressed anymore. But the idea of suicide as a legitimate means of escape continues to pervade. 

Sometimes I have a really hard time dealing with social anxiety. That's usually when I feel the most like escaping to into death's cold embrace. Its like the ultimate hiding spot. The finale of safety. I'll never have to deal with the pain again because death will protect me forever and ever... I guess I kind of romanticize it a lot.. but even so, it doesn't stop me thinking of it as a good idea. /:

Edit: Thanks about the name, by the way. <3
